title: session-doc repo pointer (.session-doc.json)
description: Committed at the repo root. Tells session-doc which Notion page tracks THIS project. Same value for every worktree of the project.

notion_page_id.description: Notion page id (32 hex chars, no dashes) of the project's status/Index page.

notion_url.description: Optional human-readable URL of the page.

openspec_dir.description: Relative path to the openspec directory for technical session docs.
